what: Stopped after building the KPI instrumentation and view; waited for a go-ahead to start the product
cause: Ended the turn with a plan and a question instead of continuing
fix: orch-product-team: a stop to ask a human is a defect; user-prompt hook counts every prompt after the first

what: Stopped again after the checks to ask whether to continue
cause: Same habit: reported state and asked, instead of acting on the standing instruction to run to completion
fix: Same, plus one human gate only (final acceptance)

what: Halted on a barrier: a protected acceptance test was wrong and no agent was allowed to fix it
cause: Eval defect with no owner. The harness freezes acceptance tests during a run; the only route out was a human
fix: Plan phase makes a separate agent the test owner; an eval defect is diagnosed, amended by that owner and logged in decisions.md, no human

what: Hard stop on the account usage limit while the code review was running
cause: No limit handling: a background agent died and its outcome was recorded as success
fix: Foreground agents, outcome-not-reported accounting, status.md plus a scheduled resume at the reset time

what: After upgrading, asked to try again; the stopped review did not run
cause: The failed agent was never resumed; the session moved on
fix: Resume stopped agents with SendMessage after the limit resets, without waiting to be told
